feedback: The first rotation-only concept missed the circular Xradar casing, two subwing pods and four-throat propulsion layout. Original SciTek technical views provide clearer evidence and triggered a real second ImageGen iteration.
Selected iteration 2, current GLB and original wire diagrams agree on those principal assemblies and the elongated slab hull/rounded bow/red outboard markings.

Current GLB sensor is more domed, its subwing pods more rounded, and deck panel/wear detailing simpler than the concept. Exact concept pod section, collar routing and seam geometry are interpretations, not recovered measurements.

Current four-nozzle GLB is the accepted SciTek source; do not revert to the initial two-engine/rectangular-block study or use rejected concept 1 as geometry authority. No new final artistic/client acceptance is granted.
